def pluck(arr):
    
    if(len(arr) == 0): return []
    evens = list(filter(lambda x: x%2 == 0, arr))
    if(evens == []): return []

# Unit test for function pluck
def test_pluck():
    assert pluck([]) == []
    assert pluck([1, 3, 5]) == []  # no even numbers
    assert pluck([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 0]  # smallest even at index 0
    assert pluck([5, 0, 3, 0, 4, 2]) == [0, 1]  # duplicates: first index of min
    assert pluck([4, 2, 3]) == [2, 1]  # min even not at first position
    assert pluck([1]) == []  # single odd element
    assert pluck([8]) == [8, 0]  # single even element
    assert pluck([-4, -2, 3, 5]) == [-4, 0]  # negative evens
    assert pluck([7, 1, 9, 2, 4]) == [2, 3]  # min even in middle
    assert pluck([0]) == [0, 0]  # zero is even
    assert pluck([3, 6, 3, 6]) == [6, 1]  # smallest even repeated
